source_revision: not-reviewed: provider terms not read; automation surface per docs/research/headless-ai-coding-controller-verified-2026-10-12.md (R2, 2026-10-12)
notes: Automation surface: `claude -p` with structured output, resume and `claude auth status`, per R2 sections 'Verified provider adapter design' (adapter matrix) and 'Compliance and authentication boundary'; TDD 4.1. Version: 2.1.296 is what `claude --version` reported on the development host on 2026-10-12 (version flag only; no prompt run, no conformance suite yet). Assumption: the range >=2.1.296 <2.2.0 (same minor series) is a Proposed conservative bound, not a provider statement; R2 gives no version numbers. Credentials: Switchboard never reads, copies, logs or exports Claude Code credentials, never starts login and never scrapes dashboards or reimplements the network protocol; it asks the native CLI for status and returns AUTH_REQUIRED naming the native login (ADR-0003, FR-AUTH-02). Terms: this manifest records that the CLI documents headless use (technical evidence only); it makes no claim that any use complies with Anthropic's terms. Commercial, resale, multi-user or credential-sharing use requires a per-provider policy review first (NFR-COMP-01). Review date: 2026-10-12 (Delegated agent review, not owner-approved). Git writes (FR-GIT-01, T2.2): verified against `claude --help` 2.1.296 text only (no prompt run). Documented controls used: `--disallowedTools <tools...>` (help: "Comma or space-separated list of tool names to deny (e.g. \"Bash(git *) Edit\")") carries deny rules `Bash(git <verb>)` and `Bash(git <verb> *)` for commit, ref-changing and push subcommands, git global options (-C, -c, --git-dir, --work-tree) and `gh`; `--restricted` (help: "lets only a person or the configured permission handler approve writes to settings, git and tool-configuration files") with `--permission-prompts none`; and no Bash tool unless the operator allowlists exact commands, where any entry that could write Git makes the run Ineligible. Assumptions: `*` matches any suffix, deny wins over allow, and deny rules for a tool absent from --tools are accepted. Limits: the rules are lexical (no aliases, scripts run by an allowlisted build tool, or absolute paths to git). Commit and attribution: the help documents no flag that disables Claude Code's own commit or attribution behaviour except `--bare` ("skip ... attribution"), which forces API-key auth and is not used (ADR-0015); settings files are never written (FR-POL-08). Remaining controls: FR-GIT-03 (M9) and FR-GIT-06. Live behaviour unverified (live smoke check C-G2). Native controls (T3.0, 2026-10-13, TDD 4.1.1; Delegated): the installed `claude --help` 2.1.296 (read only, no prompt run) lists no sandbox option and no network option; "sandboxes" appears only in the advice on `--dangerously-skip-permissions` and `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions`, so no per-run native sandbox exists without `--settings` or global configuration, and a settings-based one is Unknown until the live check T3.9 (R-10; `--settings` is also barred by ADR-0015). Compile matrix (T3.5, 2026-10-13; Delegated, Proposed, argv tests only, no prompt run): inspect-untrusted and edit-untrusted compile as in M2; trusted-development compiles with the same flags as edit-untrusted (--safe-mode --restricted --strict-mcp-config, dontAsk, --permission-prompts none, explicit --tools/--allowedTools, the Git --disallowedTools deny rules) when its network is off, its shell is none or an exact allowlist, and its repository configuration is disabled; network allowlist or policy, shell broad (Q-34) and repository configuration approved-only or allowlisted are Ineligible: CAPABILITY_MISSING (no documented control); test-sandboxed stays Ineligible: PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED (FR-POL-06, R-10, Q-16) until T3.9 or T3.1; privileged and any bypass stay Ineligible: PROFILE_UNSUPPORTED until T3.17. Network off holds at the tool level only, so an allowlisted command is not network-confined (R-36, Q-34); `--restricted` refuses bypassPermissions, which conflicts with a bypass scope (Q-33). Linux only; macOS (NFR-PORT-02) and Windows (NFR-PORT-03) are not supported yet.
